QuestInfo.name: Matters of the Heart
QuestInfo.0: The rot swallowed #b#p0000707##k's forging fire. Realizing the sickness is a living malice, he wants me to take the scorched scroll to the alchemist #b#p711##k.
QuestInfo.1: I need to deliver the #b#t4031115##k to #b#p711##k in #b#m010006140##k to see if he can explain the living malice.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the scroll to #b#p711##k. He was fascinated by the volatile anomaly and agreed to investigate.

0.0: This malevolent energy is coming straight from the deepest roots of the World Tree... I can't fight a living curse with crafting tools. We need someone who has knowledge of both the surface and the magic down here...
0.1: Take this #b#t4031115##k. It's the ruined parchment left on my anvil.
0.2: Take it to #b#p711##k who passed through earlier. He set up camp down in #b#m010006140##k.\nSee if he can explain what just ate my forging fire!

yes.0: Excellent. The scroll is highly unstable, so handle it carefully. Hurry to his camp!

no.0: We can't just sit here and wait for the rot to consume Myra! Please, hurry!

1.0: Ah, another surface-dweller! You've come from the fairy sanctuary above?
1.1: You look like you're carrying something highly unstable.\nHand me that #b#t4031115##k. I'd love to take a look at it!

item.0: You don't have the #b#t4031115##k? I cannot analyze empty air! Go back and get it!

npc.0: Still here? #b#p711##k set up camp in #b#m010006140##k. Take the #b#t4031115##k to him before it crumbles in your bag!

lost.0: You lost the #b#t4031115##k?\nThis is no time for sloppy inventory management! Take this replacement and be careful!
